item.title: Texas Sues Odessa Container Firm Over 2024 Chemical Fire, Toxic Contamination
item.description: AUSTIN, TX — Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has filed a lawsuit against an Odessa-based container company and its owners, alleging they caused a catastrophic chemical fire in 2024 and failed to clean up toxic contamination that spread into a West Texas neighborhood.
